issues.description: `id` typed as `string` but UUID libraries sometimes return branded types — use a branded `TodoId` type for type safety.
issues.suggestion: type TodoId = string & { readonly __brand: "TodoId" }; interface Todo { id: TodoId; ... }

issues.description: `status` field uses a plain string type instead of a discriminated union or enum.
issues.suggestion: type TodoStatus = 'pending' | 'active' | 'completed'; — this narrows the type at compile time and prevents invalid values.

codeQuality.summary: Good start on TypeScript migration. Type definitions are mostly sound. Consider branded ID types and status enums to leverage TypeScript's type system more fully.

untestedPaths.location: Type guard isTodo(value: unknown): value is Todo
untestedPaths.reasoning: No runtime type guard exists; deserializing from localStorage could yield invalid shapes at runtime.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should return false for malformed todo", () => { expect(isTodo({ id: 123 })).toBe(false); });

testCoverage.summary: Type definition files don't need test coverage, but a runtime type guard would improve resilience against bad data from localStorage or API.

suggestions.description: Use `as const` and `typeof` to derive the TodoStatus union from an array, keeping a single source of truth.
suggestions.after:
const TODO_STATUSES = ['pending', 'active', 'completed'] as const;
type TodoStatus = typeof TODO_STATUSES[number];
suggestions.benefits: Enables runtime iteration over valid statuses (e.g. for filter buttons) while keeping compile-time type safety.

refactorings.summary: Type definitions are clean. Small modernization using `as const` would unify runtime and compile-time representations of status values.

issues.description: Props interface uses `any` for the `onToggle` callback type, defeating TypeScript's type checking.
issues.suggestion: Type it as `onToggle: (id: TodoId) => void` to catch call-site mismatches at compile time.

issues.description: List items use array index as `key` prop. Reordering tasks will cause React to unmount/remount DOM nodes unnecessarily.
issues.suggestion: Use the stable todo `id` as the key: `key={todo.id}`

issues.description: Component handles both data fetching and rendering. This violates single-responsibility.
issues.suggestion: Split into a container (TodoListContainer) that fetches data and a presentational (TodoList) that only renders.

codeQuality.summary: TodoList.tsx has a high-severity type escape hatch (any callback), a key-prop bug that can cause subtle rendering issues, and mixed concerns.

untestedPaths.reasoning: The toggle handler is the core interaction but its invocation is not tested.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should call onToggle with correct id when checkbox clicked", () => { const onToggle = vi.fn(); render(<TodoList todos={mockTodos} onToggle={onToggle} />); fireEvent.click(getByRole("checkbox", { name: /buy milk/i })); expect(onToggle).toHaveBeenCalledWith("todo-1"); });

untestedPaths.location: TodoList when todos prop is empty array
untestedPaths.reasoning: Empty list renders an empty ul which may confuse users — an empty state message should be shown.
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: it("should render empty state message when todos is empty", () => { render(<TodoList todos={[]} onToggle={vi.fn()} />); expect(getByText(/no tasks yet/i)).toBeInTheDocument(); });

testCoverage.summary: Good baseline coverage but the critical onToggle callback invocation is untested. Add interaction tests.

suggestions.location: Lines 50–80: data-fetching logic mixed with JSX
suggestions.description: Separate data fetching into a container component and keep TodoList as a pure presentational component.
suggestions.benefits: Enables snapshot testing of the pure component, eliminates async complexity from UI tests, and makes the component reusable with any data source.

suggestions.description: Replace index-based keys with stable ID-based keys to prevent React reconciliation bugs on reorder.
suggestions.benefits: Prevents incorrect component reuse during list reordering and improves animation/transition correctness.

refactorings.summary: TodoList.tsx needs container/presentational separation and stable list keys. Both are high-impact changes that will improve testability and correctness.

recommendations.description: Replace `any` callback type in TodoList props with the correct typed signature to leverage TypeScript correctly.
Add interaction test for onToggle callback invocation — this is the core feature of the component.
Replace index-based list keys with stable `todo.id` keys to prevent React reconciliation bugs.
Split TodoList into a container component (data fetching) and a presentational component (rendering).
Use `as const` pattern for TodoStatus to unify runtime iteration and compile-time type safety.
